verses.text: rud lis salaatiina yaa qahhaaru fii abadin
waltahminii wakfinii makran wa shaytaanaa
rajawtu annaka tahmiinii wa tansurunii
nasran haziizan binaylii minka ridwaanaa
wa qaytanii makra ahdaa-ii wa man mahahum
faltakfinii sarmadan hiqdan wa hudwaanaa
ighfir zunuubii wa hab lil yawma matlabatii
bikun wa rumma bihi lii sarmadan shaanaa
lii hab firaaqil lazii lam tardahu khuluqan
waltamhu hanniya yaa ghaffaaru maa shaanaa
bihurmatil mustafaa man sirtu khaadimahu
bin nazmi wan nashri sajhan summa miizaanaa
hajjii biqalbii taqabbal wakfinii khata-an
waltamhu shaynii waa kammilnii bimaa zaanaa
rabbis tajib waltukamil maa nawaytu ladaa
tuubal latii bika tubnaa fiika bun-yaanaa
wajjahtu wajhiya yawmas sabti murtadiyan
ilal lazii sarmadan in qaala kun kaanaa
rabbun kariimun hafiizun waasihun samadun
wa abtaghii minhu taysiran wa iskaanaa
zid hilmiyal yawma zaydan qad yubashshirunii
fat-han wa faydan wa rud lid dahra sajjaanaa
qadiiru qahhaaru yaa jabbaaru yaa gharadii
rud lil lazii yaa khuzul amwaala majjaanaa
naajaytukal yawma yaa barran halayya lahu
shukrun yukhajjilu yaa quutan wa marjaanaa
antal haliyyul haziimul hadlu yaa amalii
antal haliimul haliimul barru rahmaanaa
hab lii bihaqqi tihil asmaa-i qahriya man
amsaa yukaabidu ahlal haqqi azmaanaa
minkal tamastul lazii ahtaytahus sulahaa
hattaa bihi qaharul ahdaa-i idmaanaa
mallikniyal yawma yaa wahhaabu matlabatii
waltakfinii kayda man lil hirsi qad maanaa
naajaytukal yawma zaa faqrin ilayka fakun
lii mughniyan waftahan lil yawma biibaanaa
iftah liyal yawma bil mukhtaari sayyidinaa
abwaaba khayrin tajurrur rizqa ibbaanaa
lii kun bijuudin wa is-haadin wa marhamatin
wa bil bushaaraati yaa man fadluhu baanaa
tayyib hayaatii bilaa mawtin walaa dararin
wajhal bifadlika muksii rabbi qurbaanaa
yassir jamiihal lazii arjuu wa atlubuhu
hattaa akuuna qariiral hayni jazlaanaa
yaa rabbi qud liya fid daarayni kulla munan
waltakfinii abadan makran wa khizlaanaa
bayyin liyal haqqa kashfan laa yufaariqunii
kamaaa kashafta li-ahlil laahi tib-yaanaa
isrif quluubal ahaadii han azaaya mahan
linusrati wahdibi shiiban wa fit-yaanaa
tarakut amsil lazii qad bihtuhu wa madaa
fad dahra baddil wa hannii kuffa khiz-yaanaa
wajjih liyal kashfa wat taskhiina duura hanan
waltakfinii sarmadan jahlan wa khusraanaa
fattaahu hab liya fat-han qad yurii hajaban
yaa khayra haadin hadaa ghumran wa hayraanaa
diftul kariimal lazii yuqrii bikun abadan
wa an uhaawana fii tuubaaya qad aanaa
diftul kariimal lazii fil barri karramanii
wal bahri iz saaqa lii bil faydi qur-aanaa
